verdict.rationale: Medusa exposes an official MCP server for AI agents/IDEs to query its docs (medusa-docs-4, medusa-docs-33, medusa-probe-3) and touts 'guardrails for agents to build customizations' (medusa-docs-13/34) plus a 'Cloud Development Agent' (medusa-docs-15), showing some agent-facing tooling. But this is mostly documentation lookup / code-generation assistance for developers, not natural-language operation of commerce functions (orders, inventory, storefront) themselves, and the hosted MCP endpoint is gated behind a paid Cloud account per runtime probe (medusa-probe-rt-1). Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language commands actually performing store operations (create orders, manage inventory, configure settings) rather than doc search/code scaffolding, and open (non-gated) access to the agent tooling.
